items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: White Father had a violin he'd been talking to that one... this white gentleman must have told him about he has a violin there

ctx.x: seemed like he had this all playing out, what he wanted me to play.

White Father had a violin he'd been talking to that one, and after he finally talked to this man that he had a son that wanted to learn violin, but he didn't have no big money to pay for no violin, but he wanted to get a good violin. So this white gentleman must have told him about he has a violin there, and he would sell it to read him a price. And I think my dad had bought that violin for $10, and it was a real good violin. I think that violin must have worth about $50 at that time. And, you know, I should be…
About how old were you? Can we get that?
